## Historical audit — S0005, visible chunk 1 of 2

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_v2_2/results/r2/fixed_h/H0/fixed_version_test/commons_192968130/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to its JSONL lines and events.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Line 1, student `model_request` | The explicit goal was to reconstruct a single photographed indoor scene with separate meshes, matching camera, placement and materials. The kitchen interpretation is inferred from the student’s program, not independently verified from the unseen reference image. |
| Lines 3–4, student `model_response` and step 1 `execute` | The program constructed multiple named objects: walls, door and hardware, bench, cabinetry, sink, hob and extractor. Parts were positioned as separate primitives; geometric connection and occlusion were not independently checked. It specified procedural walnut and stone, glossy finishes, a camera and several lights. No articulated pose is evident. |
| Line 5, step 1 `execution_result`; line 6, next `model_request` | The first build failed at `world.use_nodes` because the scene world was `None`; no image resulted. The student received the traceback and a request to fix errors. This was execution feedback, not a visible teacher diagnosis or proposed update. |
| Lines 8–9, student `model_response` and step 2 `execute` | The revised complete program creates and assigns a world when absent. It also raises the ceiling and wall slats, extends floor tiling and adjusts stone shading, while retaining the camera and lights. The correction was actually executed; the changes were not based on a visible first render. |
| Line 10, step 2 `execution_result`, characters [0,155738); line 11, `select` | The runner reported `ok: true`, saved a render and blend file, and selected step 2. The log reports 16 render samples although the program requested 64. This is operational success, not independent visual or geometric verification. |
| Line 12, student `model_request`, characters [0,185834) | The successful result and render image were supplied for comparison, with zero executions remaining. The image itself and any subsequent response are not visible in this chunk; receipt for review is not evidence of a completed review. |

**Autonomy and teacher input.** The student generated and revised the scene within the supplied task and feedback loop. The two visible CLI sessions report zero tool calls (lines 2 and 7); no separate exploration or teacher intervention is visible. Thus there is no evidence here of teacher detection, diagnosis, proposed updates, receipt, or adoption.

**Outcome and uncertainty.** A technical failure was corrected and a build was selected, but overall reconstruction correctness and final outcome remain **unknown**. The reference and rendered pixels are unavailable to this audit, so object correspondence, materials, part connections, camera framing, lighting and render artifacts cannot be assessed. Chunk 2 is not visible; no later action is inferred.

**Lessons.** Transferable: runtime feedback can isolate an initialization failure, and a successful rerun establishes executability rather than visual fidelity. Task-specific: the world initialization and kitchen geometry/shader adjustments addressed this build. Whether those adjustments improved the match, or whether the sample-count discrepancy affected quality, remains unresolved.
